chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
A friend is not a friend unless he affords protection to his comrade on three occasions: in his adversity, in his absence and at his death.

key_terms.غَيْبَتِهِ: His absence / when he is away
key_terms.نَكْبَتِهِ: His adversity / misfortune / time of hardship

ai.seo_question: What are the three occasions that define a true friend according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) defines true friendship by three key tests of loyalty: standing by a friend in their time of hardship (nakat), during their absence (ghabah), and at their death (wafah). This hadith emphasizes that genuine friendship requires active protection and support across these distinct phases of life. In Shia scholarly tradition, this triad highlights the transition from public to private loyalty, ensuring that a friend's dignity remains intact even when they are no longer present to witness it, reflecting the concept of *siddiqiyyah* (truthfulness in bond).
